name: Electronics and device repair shop

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Laptop repair
services.story: The main story: a laptop that won't hold a charge. Only the $49 diagnosis is promised. Tyler's written estimate is OK'd before any work, the battery is ordered, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Computer tune-up
services.story: A $35 computer tune-up from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: Laptop repair
services.story: The laptop repair, with the bill texted once it's ready, so Alex can pay before pick-up.

services.name: Computer tune-up
services.story: A $35 computer tune-up. Rosie texts the bill with READY.

services.name: Chromebook screen
services.story: A $140 Chromebook screen whose part is ordered in. A $40 deposit orders it, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Phone screen repair
services.story: The main story: a $179 phone screen at Alex's home. A card is saved for the $89 on-site fee, charged only for a late cancel or a no-show, and only on Sam's yes. Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Computer repair
services.story: A computer that freezes, priced at the visit. A card is saved for the $89 on-site fee.

services.name: Phone screen repair
services.story: The $179 phone screen. A card is saved, and charged when Ethan texts DONE.

services.name: Laptop screen replacement
services.story: A cracked laptop screen, priced from photos at $640. Sam OKs it. A $160 deposit orders the part, and the rest is on the bill.
